conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Traditional smartphones rely on cellular networks for communication, while satellite phones connect directly to orbiting satellites. This difference in connectivity greatly impacts their coverage and reliability, especially in remote areas.

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For instance, many satellite phones are waterproof, dustproof, and shock-resistant, making them ideal for adventurers, emergency responders, or those working in remote industrial settings. Some models even float.
